page.layout: One title page, centred. From top to bottom: "LEGES ATTICÆ" in black capitals; "SAM. PETITVS" in large red capitals; "COLLEGIT, DIGESSIT," in black capitals; "ET" in spaced capitals; "LIBRO COMMENTARIO" in large red capitals; "ILLVSTRAVIT." in black capitals; "OPVS IVRIS, LITERARVM, ET REI" in red italic capitals; four lines of black italic text; below them an engraved vignette with the labels ASIA and AFRICA at its top corners and a dial with letters at the centre. The vignette is cut off at the bottom of this part. Library stamps at left and right are left out.; Engraved title frame at top, with small captions in its lower corners; below it, centred: red "PARISIIS.", an imprint line, a rule, red date line, and an italic line "CVM PRIVILEGIO REGIS."

main_text.l: Sumptibus CAROLI MORELLI, via Iacobæâ ad insigne Fontis.

page.notes: The engraved vignette is cut off at the bottom of this part; it shows figures at the left and right, fruit and foliage, and a large dial with the letters N and B at the visible edge. The two letters on the dial are partly visible and are transcribed as seen. The handwritten number at the top and the two oval library stamps (Biblioteca Nazionale, Roma) are not printed text and are left out. The engraving shows a fountain within a zodiac ring; the Greek and Latin ring lettering is only partly visible and is not transcribed beyond the marked illegible line. Handwritten marginal labels, the handwritten initials "B.S.", the blue library stamp and the digitiser's watermark are left out.
